articles.title: Quote of the day by Jean-Jacques Rousseau: 'It is too difficult to think nobly when one thinks only of...' Life lessons from motivational quote on economic precarity, personal growth, daily struggle, survival, higher contemplation, financial independence, mental and physical energy
articles.description: Quote of the day by Jean-Jacques Rousseau reminds people that constant concern about earning money can reduce the time and energy needed for learning, creativity, and personal growth. The quote explains how financial pressure affects thinking and decision-making. It also offers lessons on balancing work with personal development, managing time, building financial independence, and making space for knowledge, purpose, and meaningful contributions in everyday life.

articles.title: The Rs 7.50 lakh myth: Why employer's NPS contribution must be included in salary for claiming deduction under Section 80CCD(2)
articles.description: As the due date for filing ITRs for AY 2026-27 approaches, many salaried taxpayers are finding that the ITR utility does not allow deduction under Section 80CCD(2) unless the employer's NPS contribution is first included in salary. This article explains why the ITR utility is designed to work this way by examining the relevant provisions of the Income-Tax Act, 1961 and dispelling some common misconceptions.

articles.title: 10 major changes in ITR forms for AY 2026-2027 that you must know before filing ITR

These updates aim to enhance transparency and compliance for all taxpayers.
